unlogged_window_bound.rule: firmware logs a window only if p>0.2 or as 5 s heartbeat; so an unlogged window has mean<=0.2, max(MLP,CNN)<=0.4, min<=0.2, w*MLP+(1-w)*CNN<=0.4*max(w,1-w)
unlogged_window_bound.conclusive_if: threshold is strictly above the bound for the rule used (mean/min thresholds >0.2, max/weighted-mean >0.4*max(w,1-w))
unlogged_window_bound.caveat: not airtight: live5#2 shows a window with mean 0.69 (aiMax6s) that was never logged; such windows are detected via aiMax6s but a dropped non-maximal window cannot be

method.host_timestamp_jitter: live_ai.py stamps lines on arrival; ring membership (6 s) can be off by ~0.5 s
method.live1: AI alarm mode OFF: FSM ran the legacy rule (var thresholds 0.08/0.8, 3 s window); non-informative for current firmware and path B; path A replayed as counterfactual
method.codes: A/B = alarm via path A/B, '-' none, '?' inconclusive, lowercase 'a' = counterfactual path A on the ai=0 log, trailing 'c' = path A would have fired but the 30 s cooldown blocked it
